files_summary.datasets.json: Array of dataset objects. Each object contains: id (repo identifier), name, description (concise summary), tasks (list), modalities (list), languages (list), size (e.g., token count or storage size), license, and a direct Hugging Face link.
files_summary.models.json: Array of model objects. Each object includes: id (repo identifier), name, description (brief overview), task (primary ML task), license, and a direct Hugging Face link.
files_summary.papers.json: Array of research paper objects. Each object holds: title, summary (short description of contribution), and category (research area).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: list_datasets
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of dataset catalog entries, optionally filtered by tasks, modalities, languages, and license. It refuses requests with invalid pagination (negative offset, non-positive or non-integer limit) or malformed filter values (e.g., non-string items in tasks/modalities/languages). If filters reference values we don’t recognize or can’t match, the request is rejected rather than returning an ambiguous result set.

limit.description: Maximum number of datasets to return.

offset.description: Number of datasets to skip before returning.

tasks.description: Filter datasets that include any of these tasks.

modalities.description: Filter datasets by one or more modalities.

tool_schemas.name: get_dataset
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full metadata record for the dataset identified by dataset_id (for example, an "owner/name" slug). It refuses requests where dataset_id is missing, empty, or not a valid identifier format. It also refuses requests for dataset IDs that do not exist in the catalog.

dataset_id.description: The unique identifier of the dataset (e.g., 'username/dataset-name').

tool_schemas.name: list_models
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of model catalog entries, optionally filtered by primary task, author, and license. It refuses requests with invalid pagination (negative offset, non-positive or non-integer limit) or non-string filter values. It also refuses filter combinations that cannot be applied (for example, unsupported task/license values) instead of returning misleading partial matches.

limit.description: Maximum number of models to return.

offset.description: Number of models to skip before returning.

task.description: Filter models by their primary task.

author.description: Filter models by author or organization name.

tool_schemas.name: get_model
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full metadata record for the model identified by model_id (for example, an "owner/name" slug). It refuses requests where model_id is missing, empty, or not a valid identifier format. It also refuses requests for model IDs that do not exist in the catalog.

model_id.description: The unique identifier of the model (e.g., 'username/model-name').

tool_schemas.name: list_papers
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of research paper entries, optionally limited to a single category. It refuses requests with invalid pagination (negative offset, non-positive or non-integer limit) or a non-string category value. It also refuses category filters that don’t correspond to a supported paper category.

limit.description: Maximum number of papers to return.

offset.description: Number of papers to skip before returning.

tool_schemas.name: search_papers
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of papers whose titles or summaries match the provided free-text query, optionally constrained to a category. It refuses requests where query is missing, empty, or not a string, and it refuses invalid pagination values. If a category is provided, the request is refused when the category is not recognized or cannot be applied.

query.description: Search term to match against paper titles and summaries.

limit.description: Maximum number of papers to return.

offset.description: Number of papers to skip before returning.

metadata.name: AtlasForge Research Catalog
metadata.description: A unified browse-and-search service for retrieving metadata on machine-learning datasets, models, and research papers via simple listing, lookup, and paper search APIs.
